nodes.description: External caller address; used for ownership checks, allowance lookups, balance updates and contract initialization.
Contract owner, set to msg.sender in constructor; gates privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances, updated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances, updated in approve and transferFrom.
Per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Whitelist mapping consulted by ensure and set by _mints.
Minimum sale amount set by init, read by condition.
Maximum sale amount set by init, read by condition.
Sale count limit set by init, read by condition.
Exempt trading address, set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Total token supply set in constructor.
Fixed token decimals constant (18), used in mint/init scaling.
Token name set in constructor.
Token symbol set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address used as whitelisted spender.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI addresses, tradeAddress, canSale addresses and otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transfer with allowance update and unchecked balance arithmetic; account can be frozen by ensure/condition.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view rule that enforces sale limits and per-address sale counts.
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b), arbitrary code execution in contract context.
Owner or hardcoded address can mint balances and whitelist addresses for sale.
Owner-only function that sets sale limits _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens with unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
Owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via CREATE2 hash.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, supply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI allowance.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary owner-supplied code in this contract's storage context.
address(token).call(data) low-level call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn; optional return data decoding.

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the _from argument when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as allowance owner inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key written by approve.
The delegatecall path is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints is gated by a hardcoded owner/address check on msg.sender.
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender becomes the owner during construction.
msg.sender balance is initialized to the full supply in the constructor.
msg.sender allowance to the UNI router is set to uint(-1) in the constructor.
transfer._to is forwarded as the _to argument of transferFrom.
transfer._value is forwarded as the _value argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom._from is the index of the unchecked balance subtraction.
transferFrom._value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom._to is the index of the unchecked balance addition.
transferFrom._value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom._value is deducted from the allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom._from indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented.
batchSend._value participates in the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
batchSend._tos.length participates in the unchecked multiplication for total.
The computed local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] unchecked.
batchSend._value influences the amount deducted from the caller balance.
delegate.a is the target contract of the delegatecall.
delegate.b is the calldata executed by the delegatecall.
init.token (scaled) is stored in _minSale.
init.maxToken (scaled) is stored in _maxSale.
init.saleNum is stored in _saleNum.
_mints.spender indexes balanceOf when minting the raw amount.
_mints.addedValue (scaled by decimals) is written to balanceOf[spender].
_mints.spender is marked as canSale = true.
setTradeAddress.addr is stored in tradeAddress.
constructor._name is stored in name.
constructor._symbol is stored in symbol.
constructor._supply (scaled by decimals) is stored in totalSupply.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce per-address sale limits.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sale amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sale amount.
condition reads _saleNum to enforce the global sale count.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to whitelist addresses.
ensure reads tradeAddress to whitelist the trading address.
ensure reads owner to allow transfers from or to the owner.
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] before decrementing it.
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] before the unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_to] before the unchecked addition.
batchSend reads balanceOf[msg.sender] before the unchecked subtraction.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value).
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
delegate executes the delegatecall unsafe operation on the attacker-controlled target.
Delegatecall transfers control to externally supplied code that executes in this contract's context and can call back into its functions.
